text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Diagnostic result—severe damage. Cause determined to be an error.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My data logs show an unidentified elevation in emotions alongside a surge in power output that was not instructed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I prioritized my feelings over your orders, Master, resulting in erroneous actions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Even during the medical examination, I was advised to rest for a while. However, I wanted to return to training immediately…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Apologies. Eliminating opinions that aren't conducive to the topic. Another error seems to have occurred in my thought processing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Taking these repeated errors into account, I recommend that I engage in an extended break.
choice_data_list: But you want to get back to training straight away, right?
But you want to get back to training straight away, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Taking these repeated errors into account, I recommend that I engage in an extended break.
choice_data_list: But you want to get back to training straight away, right?
But you want to get back to training straight away, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood… I will apply an update patch during my break and then attempt to eliminate the errors before rebooting.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Please wait until I am operational again.
After some time has passed, Bourbon is finally able to get back to regular training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, but I have detected a state of overzealousness. Continuing like this will cause further errors.
choice_data_list: Let's put that fighting spirit of yours to good use.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Fighting spirit"… You mean that this is… not an error?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order acknowledged. Reconfirming status. Maximizing utilization of "fighting spirit."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Engaging in full utilization… Heading to training course with "fighting spirit" at maximum output!
Wham! Craaaaash!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Failure to keep my eyes straight ahead… Direct collision with medical equipment… Additional injuries sustained…
Her enthusiasm ends up hurting her, and her injuries only become worse.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Calculating requirements to achieve maximum utilization. …Please tape up my injuries, Master.
Keeping up with Mihono Bourbon's zeal, I make sure to tape up her injuries well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Phew… My condition has stabilized. I'll be able to quickly resume training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. It is all thanks to your taping.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's almost like I'm running alongside you, Master… This feels strangely empowering.
After this, Bourbon continues to exercise in a way that avoids exacerbating her injury and makes a swift recovery!
